EML4234.title: Engineering Failure Analysis
EML4234.prerequisites: Florida Polytechnic, the only carrier: not confirmed (catalog not readable). Its companion course EML4541 requires EGN3331 Strength of Materials and EGN3365 Structure and Properties of Materials, and EML4234 sits in the same Materials & Advanced Manufacturing concentration list, so expect the same. Check Florida Poly's catalog. *** SAME NUMBER, DIFFERENT COURSE: SCNS matches on the last three digits, and EML x234 is statewide 'Material Science and Engineering'. FAMU and FSU carry EML3234, a general materials science course; Florida Poly teaches failure analysis by case study. Send a syllabus on transfer either way.

offering_notes.summary: One public carrier, Florida Polytechnic University, at 3 credits. FAMU and FSU carry the SCNS-equivalent EML3234 as a general materials science course, not failure analysis.
offering_notes.derivation: Florida's convention of 45 contact hours for a 3-credit lecture course; Florida Poly does not publish hours and the statewide record marks no laboratory.

offerings.title: Engineering Failure Analysis
offerings.note: Elective in the Materials & Advanced Manufacturing concentration of the B.S. in Mechanical Engineering. Catalog: failure analysis methodology with macroscopic and microscopic examination, taught through case studies. Prerequisite not confirmed.
